metadata.title: BrowseTrace: Reproducible HTTP Traces and Cache Replay for Browser-Mediated AI Workloads
metadata.description: Author-approved research dataset/software artifact containing sanitized browser-workload replay traces, session census, the author's ten human task observations, supporting audits, reproducible measurements, and an original empirical manuscript. Not an accepted conference publication. Artifact software is Apache-2.0; released data and derived results are CC BY 4.0; manuscript distribution is separate. Publication rights and release authority are author-confirmed. This metadata has not been deposited.

local_note: Author-authorized deposit draft. Use the actual release/deposit date and version when depositing. No deposit or DOI exists; assigned identifiers must be recorded only after the external workflow completes.
